_doc: How the ACG UMA race provides each DNA channel of NpcMeshes.UmaChannels (ADR-0014, ADR-0015, docs/design/npc-uma-looks.md). kind: bone = UMA DNA bone scale/position/rotation, set up in Unity, nothing baked; target = MakeHuman target pair baked as shape keys '<name>+' / '<name>-' one net weight step (incr minus decr) away from the base spec, capped at ±1 (race.py reports the step that fitted) (both sides when it lists l- and r-); param = spec value (or acg_face's default when the spec has none) nudged by step and baked through the full ACG build; slot = carried by a wardrobe slot's own blendshape; shader = material parameter; sculpt = no source yet, a custom shape has to be made. range: the spec values a param key may be baked at (beyond it the edit breaks the mesh); a key clamped there falls short and the gate test reports it. Param keys under shape.* are acg_shape.py edits (multipliers, 1 = unchanged). Target net weights may run to ±3 (race.py TARGET_CAP, 暫定); every key is baked at the race's farthest resident on its side. cal: how race.py turns a key's measured effect (acg_measure.py) into per, the channel change one unit key weight stands for, in the mapper's own units: measure+rel = the measure scales with the channel (per = mean x relative change, x k), measure+k = the channel is an offset of k head radii per unit, step = a param nudge read directly, fixed = defined rather than measured (macros, jaw squareness, jowl, eye tilt; 暫定). ear.*Share keep per 1. mm_exempt: why the 1 mm-per-sd visibility check does not apply.

spine.lean.note: forward rotation, shared out along the spine

body.grown.note: child proportions: overall scale with a larger head; face fields carry the rest

face.skullDepth.note: acg_shape: the back of the cranium behind the head joint; head-scale-depth ran out at the target cap

face.cheekFat.note: cheek fill widens the mid-face; per is defined (0.05 fill per 0.1 cheek fat, 暫定) because the measured band width barely followed it; checked at gate 3

face.length.note: acg_shape stretch below the eye line

face.jawWidth.note: acg_shape band at the angle of the jaw; the V-taper ran out (past 1.0 it mirrors the chin)

face.chinJut.note: the build's own chin pull; unlike the chin-prognathism targets it is not capped at weight 1

face.chinHeight.note: the build's own chin drop; chin-height targets barely moved the measured chin

face.jowl.note: acg_shape fill under the chin in the procedural head's own amounts, so the value is the channel; neck-double moved under a millimetre per sd
face.jowl.mm_exempt: only heavy or old residents carry a double chin, so the spread is tiny; at full value it fills 0.06 head radii under the chin (judged at gate 3)

brow.thickness.mm_exempt: a drawn stroke: its weight reads at a fraction of a millimetre

ear.scale.note: shrink_ears runs after the targets, so the ACG ear size is this value, not ear-scale targets

ear.elfShare.note: stand-in until the race's own elf ear is modelled
ear.elfShare.mm_exempt: most residents carry none of the blood line, so the spread is tiny; a half-blood shows 0.8 of the trait (judged at gate 3)
